budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: HBM-SU3 10-17 (coordinator 0dg+3): SU-level LG pair tap hardened as its own leaf beside the pgslice VM bank leaves, with a reviewed 1-bit serial->stream reset synchroniser (clk_ctl rc -> pg_clk rs[0] -> rs[1]) instead of the r8b single pg_clk flop of the serial rst_n. Datapath = unchanged ot_hbm_vm_lg_pair_tap (10/7). Pin-bound 216x216 as the CLOSED SFU tap leaf: W far 1,112 / E near 1,112 / N local requests 596 full face / S local returns 516 + clocks/reset/selects at the S centre. Benches: tools/hbm_static/su_pg_lg_tap_rsync_run.sh (tap lockstep vs ot_hbm_vm_lg_pair_tap + exact reset edges; RSYNC_MUT=1 = r8b one-flop reset FAILS) and su_pgslice_lg_rsync_run.sh (whole pgslice_lg RSYNC=1 vs r8b at die params, leaf + tap synchronisers agree).
